MiuiIconManagerUtils clinit builds RIGHT_BLOCK_LIST (mute, micphone, headset, mikey, privacy_mode, gps, missed_call, ime, cast, bluetooth_handsfree_battery, ethernet, nfc, tty, stealth, second_space, handle, handle_battery) and CONTROL_CENTER_BLOCK_LIST (car, tv, pc, pad, phone, sound_box_group, stereo, sound_box_screen, sound_box, wireless_headset, glasses, camera, dist_compute). Membership means HIDE, not "place in the right cluster": IconManager.addHolder(ILjava/lang/String;Z...) does mBlockList.contains(slot) and forces the visible flag true before creating the view, and StatusBarIconControllerImpl.refreshIconGroup scans every StatusIconDisplayable and calls setBlocked(forced || mBlockList.contains(slot) || userHidden || systemHidden || vibrateSetting). MiuiStatusIconContainer.onLayout/onMeasure skip any icon where isIconBlocked() is true, which is exactly the effect the module own ignoredSlots path relies on. The list is a plain mutable ArrayList read per icon add, and setBlockList is called by the live StatusBarIconBlockListBinder emit and by ControlCenterFakeStatusIcons/ControlCenterStatusBarIcon/KeyguardStatusBarViewController/MiuiQSHeaderView/MiuiPhoneStatusBarView, all present on 202602260. The wifi/demo_wifi glyphs are ModernStatusBarWifiView instances created by IconManager.addHolder, so the producer is the live block list, and both slot literals are present in the APK. The first pass concluded only that the list carried no wifi entry; the corrected reading is that the list is a mutable per-icon visibility input that can carry it. Still no adapter written for this row. OPEN QUESTION for the next pass (not a status change): the local status_bar_icons card already serialises these same literals. The generic adapter IconBlockListHooks installs before-hooks on MiuiStatusIconContainer.setIgnoredSlots/addIgnoredSlots and drives MiuiStatusIconContainer.ignoredSlots, and the host simultaneously drives IconManager.mBlockList - on 202602260 HomeStatusBarIconBlockListBinder.bind -> HomeStatusBarIconBlockListBinder$bind$1$1$1.emit -> IconManager.setBlockList -> refreshIconGroup -> StatusIconDisplayable.setBlocked, and MiuiStatusIconContainer.onLayout skips the same icons through both ignoredSlots and isIconBlocked(). The slot literals in the local card do match this build for volume/mute ("volume" literal) and no_sim, so a mode-2 entry can plausibly take effect; but the local adapter was written for the ignoredSlots mechanism only. Whether the two visibility paths still agree after the local hook runs, and whether mode 11/12 render as intended for the modern wifi/mobile binders, is NOT established by this read-only pass and is not device-accepted. Recorded as an open item so nobody reads audited_carrier_found_not_migrated as proof the rows are dead.
